## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- [ ] App / UI
- [ ] Maze visualization
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository / tooling

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm type-check`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test:unit --run`
- [ ] `pnpm build-only`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e --project=chromium` (browser behavior changes)

## Change Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Internal only

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(app): ...`)
- [ ] Tests were updated when behavior changed
- [ ] README or CONTRIBUTING was updated when needed
- [ ] Cloudflare Preview was reviewed when applicable
